items.title: Vitalik Flags AI Risk to Crypto, Warns Against Rushed Wallet Moves
items.summary: Vitalik Buterin has chimed in on Ethereum’s “bunker mode” debate, sharing practical tips for addresses and multisigs.

items.title: NFL Joins States in Fight Against Prediction Markets
items.summary: After months of failed partnership talks, the NFL is backing states against Kalshi in a Supreme Court fight, as the NBA weighs its own next move.

items.title: Uniswap Universal Router SwapProxy and Periphery Audit
items.summary: OpenZeppelin audited Uniswap's SwapProxy, full-precision payments and per-hop slippage updates across Universal Router and v4 Periphery. 17 issues, 9 resolved.

items.title: Uniswap Universal Router 2.1 and V4 Periphery Audit
items.summary: OpenZeppelin's differential audit of Uniswap Universal Router 2.1 and v4 Periphery: per-hop slippage checks, RouteSigner and Across bridging. Both issues resolved.
